capabilities: Generate Q&A, cloze and image-occlusion cards from notes
Schedule reviews with FSRS and a daily due queue
Browse and filter cards with a search query language
Import Anki .apkg decks with their media
Plan exams with countdowns and per-day card estimates
disambiguation: Not a mock or placeholder card generator; it is a full spaced-repetition flashcard system.
extras: Cards, review logs and backups stay in fakecard/ folders and the plugin makes no network requests; audio recordings and Anki-style learning steps are off by default; the settings tab and the rest of the README switch between English and Chinese.
problem: Reviewing notes with spaced repetition usually means copying content into another app or editing the notes themselves to add card markup.

relations.evidence: Anki import (.apkg): basic, cloze and image-occlusion notes plus their media
links to Browse and Review the way the True Recall dashboard does

summary: Spaced-repetition flashcard system that builds Q&A, cloze and image-occlusion cards from notes and stores them as JSON in a separate folder.
